main.description: Record that a recovery bundle is still in use (decision J2): sets its lastUsedAt to the server time. Bundles with mechanism keychain or passkey that go unused for 180 days are deleted by the server together with their ORF state; code and otc bundles never expire. Any enrolled device's sync should touch the bundles it can still open; getVirtualDevice also touches the bundle it returns. Mailbox endpoint. Common errors: NotAuthorized, AccountSessionExpired, DeviceRevoked, RateLimited, InvalidRequest, PayloadTooLarge, QuotaExceeded.
